## kibot_settings.yaml: pipeline settings

Read by the launcher (`kibot_launch.sh`, `run_kibot.sh`, `run_kibot.ps1`) and the GitHub workflow. Flat `key: value` lines only: shell scripts parse this file.

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `DRAFT` | Project status, selects which outputs are generated:<br>DRAFT       : schematic in progress -> schematic PDF, netlist, BoM<br>PRELIMINARY : schematic + PCB documents (fab/assembly/gerbers/routing PDF,<br>3D renders, STEP...), no ERC/DRC<br>CHECKED     : same as PRELIMINARY, plus ERC/DRC reports<br>RELEASED    : same as CHECKED. Selected automatically in CI when a<br>semantic version tag (x.y.z) is pushed Any other name is treated as an assembly variant (outputs in Variants/<name>). |
| `assembly_variants` | ` ` | Assembly variants (KiCad 10 variants, Schematic Setup > Variants), space-separated, i.e. `assembly_variants: LITE PRO`. Generated after each CHECKED / RELEASED run (locally with ./run_kibot.sh -v NAME), outputs in Variants/<name>, BoM / pick and place / assembly files attached to the releases. Empty: none. |
| `boards` | ` ` | Multi-board repository: folders of the KiCad projects, space-separated, i.e. `boards: hw/main hw/io`. Each board gets its outputs in its folder (run one with ./run_kibot.sh --board hw/io). CHANGELOG.md, the version, the settings and the pipeline (kibot_yaml, kibot_resources) are shared. Empty: single project at the repository root. |
| `panel` | `false` | Panel of the board made with KiKit (true \| false), for the PRELIMINARY / CHECKED / RELEASED runs: Manufacturing/Panel (panel PCB, preview, Gerbers + drill ZIP). Layout (rows, columns, mouse bites / V-cuts, rails...): PANEL_* definitions in kibot_yaml/kibot_main.yaml. |
| `docker_image` | `ghcr.io/inti-cmnb/kicad10_auto_full:1.9.1-1_k10.0.5_d13.2_b4.2.4LTS` | KiBot docker image (KiCad 10 + KiBot + Blender). Pin a precise tag for reproducible builds. Tags: https://github.com/INTI-CMNB/kicad_auto/pkgs/container/kicad10_auto_full |
| `drawio_image` | `rlespinasse/drawio-export:v4.60.0` | draw.io exporter image (headless draw.io), used by run_kibot.sh --diagrams to export Diagrams/*.drawio before importing them in the schematic sheets. Tags: https://hub.docker.com/r/rlespinasse/drawio-export/tags |
| `auto_diagrams` | `true` | Import the diagrams (Diagrams/<Sheet name>.drawio\|svg\|png) changed since their last import before each generation, locally and in CI (true \| false). The updated sheets are kept: commit them. false: only with --diagrams. |
| `ci_outputs` | `branch` | CI only: where the generated outputs go (they are always available as workflow artifacts too):<br>branch : snapshot (project + outputs) force-pushed to the branch<br>kibot-outputs/<branch>, so the history of your branches doesn't<br>grow with the outputs. Releases (tags) still commit them on main.<br>commit : committed on the branch itself at each run<br>none   : artifacts only (releases still commit them on main) |
| `pr_variant` | `CHECKED` | CI only: project status used to check the pull requests (ERC/DRC need CHECKED). Nothing is committed for a pull request. |
| `ci_render_engine` | `kicad` | CI only: 3D render engine (kicad \| blender). Blender is slow on the GitHub runners (~7 min per view with 4 CPUs): keep kicad and render with Blender locally (./run_kibot.sh -r blender). A manual run can still choose blender. |

Shared libraries: `lib_<VAR>_url`, `lib_<VAR>_path`, `lib_<VAR>_branch` (see the commented example in the file and *Shared libraries* in the guide).

## kibot_main.yaml definitions: KiBot outputs

The `definitions:` section at the end of `kibot_yaml/kibot_main.yaml`, used as `@NAME@` in the KiBot files. Change them in the file, for one run with `./run_kibot.sh -- -E NAME=value`, or for one board of a multi-board repository in its `kibot_board.yaml`.

### Metadata

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_NAME` | `Project Name` | product/project, in the title blocks and README |
| `BOARD_NAME` | `Board Name` | this PCB, in the title blocks, documents and panel rail |
| `COMPANY` | `Company Name` | title blocks, fabrication notes |
| `DESIGNER` | `Author` | title blocks |
| `LOGO` | `'Logos/dummy_logo.png'` | relative to the KiCad project folder |
| `GIT_URL` | `auto` | auto: URL of the git remote (origin), or set it explicitly |
| `REVISION` | `''` | Revision. Normally overridden by kibot_launch.sh (-E REVISION=...), which computes it from CHANGELOG.md or from the git tag in CI. |

### Preflight

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CHECK_ZONE_FILLS` | `false` | DRC: refill the zones before checking. false: check the fills saved in the PCB, the ones the Gerbers use (refill in KiCad, or --stackup does it) |
| `STACKUP_TABLE_NOTE` | `external layer thicknesses are specified after plating` | Note under the stackup table of the fabrication document |

### BoM

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MPN_FIELD` | `'Manufacturer Part Number'` | symbol field with the part number (BoM grouping) |
| `MAN_FIELD` | `'Manufacturer'` | symbol field with the manufacturer |

### Drill table and drill map parameters

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GROUP_ROUND_SLOTS` | `true` | whether or not to group round holes and slots |
| `GROUP_PTH_NPTH` | `'no'` | for drill tables (CSV, PCB Print) |
| `GROUP_PTH_NPTH_DRL` | `false` | for .drl files |

### Gerber parameters

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PLOT_REFS` | `true` | reference designators |

### PDF documents parameters

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `COLOR_THEME` | `Altium_Theme` | KiCad color theme of the PCB PDFs (kibot_resources/colors) |
| `SHEET_WKS` | `${KIPRJMOD}/Templates/Template_PCB_GIT_A4.kicad_wks` | drawing sheet of the PCB PDFs |
| `FAB_SCALING` | `1` | fabrication document, board drawing scale |
| `ASSEMBLY_SCALING` | `1` | assembly document, board drawing scale |
| `ROUTING_SCALING` | `0` | PCB routing PDF, 0 = fit the page |
| `GERBERS_PDF_SCALING` | `0` | Gerbers PDF, 0 = fit the page |
| `GERBERS_PDF_MONOCHROME` | `false` | Gerbers PDF in gray scale instead of colors |

### References to exclude from testpoint highlighting

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EXCLUDE_REFS` | `'[MB*]'` | for components on the PCB but not on the schematic |

### Set by kibot_launch.sh

Given by the launcher on the command line (-E), don't change them here: OUTPUT_ROOT = output folder of the run (the notes are read back from it, Variants/<name> for an assembly variant), PROJECT_DIR = folder of the KiCad project (multi-board), ASSEMBLY_VARIANT(_COMMENT) = assembly variant of the run (-v NAME) and its description. The placeholder must not be `Default`: KiBot uses the `Default` KiCad variant for the outputs without variant.

Internal names, change them only with the files using them.

`OUTPUT_ROOT` = `.` · `PROJECT_DIR` = `.` · `ASSEMBLY_VARIANT` = `NO_ASSEMBLY_VARIANT` · `ASSEMBLY_VARIANT_COMMENT` = `Unused`

### 3D renders

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RENDER_ENGINE` | `kicad` | Render engine used for the PNG previews:<br>kicad   : KiCad 3D viewer (kicad-cli pcb render), fast<br>blender : photo-realistic render with Blender + pcb2blender, slow Override from the command line with: ./kibot_launch.sh --render blender |
| `3D_RESOLUTION` | `2000` | Image width/height in pixels |
| `KICAD_3D_RAYTRACING` | `false` | KiCad engine: ray tracing is nicer but adds a floor shadow around the board |
| `KICAD_3D_ROT_X` | `-30` | Angled views, KiCad engine, in degrees. Avoid Z rotations here: the KiCad renderer can't zoom out, a rotated board would be clipped |
| `KICAD_3D_ROT_Y` | `-20` | Angled views, KiCad engine, in degrees. Avoid Z rotations here: the KiCad renderer can't zoom out, a rotated board would be clipped |
| `BLENDER_3D_ROT_X` | `20` | Angled views, Blender engine, in degrees |
| `BLENDER_3D_ROT_Y` | `-10` | Angled views, Blender engine, in degrees |
| `BLENDER_3D_ROT_Z` | `10` | Angled views, Blender engine, in degrees |
| `BLENDER_3D_ROT_Z_BOTTOM` | `-10` | Angled views, Blender engine, in degrees |
| `BLENDER_SAMPLES` | `50` | Blender engine only: 10 = draft, 100+ = final |

### JLCPCB

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JLCPCB_TEMPLATE` | `JLCPCB` | JLCPCB: SMD only assembly, JLCPCB_with_THT: SMD + through hole assembly (also available: JLCPCB_stencil, JLCPCB_stencil_with_THT) |

### Panel (KiKit)

Generated when `panel: true` in kibot_settings.yaml, in PANEL_DIR: panel PCB, preview, Gerbers + drill ZIP to order it at JLCPCB (panel by customer). Rails top/bottom with tooling holes and fiducials, board title and revision on the top rail.

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PANEL_CUTS` | `mousebites` | mousebites (any shape) \| vcuts (rectangles only) |
| `PANEL_ROWS` | `2` | boards per column |
| `PANEL_COLS` | `2` | boards per row |
| `PANEL_SPACE` | `2` | mm between boards (mousebites only) |
| `PANEL_TAB_WIDTH` | `3` | mm (mousebites only) |
| `PANEL_TAB_COUNT` | `2` | tabs per board edge (mousebites only) |
| `PANEL_RAIL_WIDTH` | `5` | mm, JLCPCB assembly needs >= 5 |
| `PANEL_MIN_SIZE` | `70` | mm, JLCPCB Standard PCBA minimum (0: none) |

### KiRI (visual diff between commits)

| Definition | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KIRI_MAX_COMMITS` | `5` | commits compared in the KiRI page |

### Output directories

Folders of the outputs, relative to the output folder of the run (the project, Variants/<name> or a board folder). The documents, README, CI summary and release step expect these defaults.

Internal names, change them only with the files using them.

`OUTPUT_DIR` = `./` · `REPORT_DIR` = `Reports` · `SCHEMATIC_DIR` = `Schematic` · `PCB_DIR` = `PCB` · `MANUFACTURING_DIR` = `Manufacturing` · `ASSEMBLY_DIR` = `'@MANUFACTURING_DIR@/Assembly'` · `FABRICATION_DIR` = `'@MANUFACTURING_DIR@/Fabrication'` · `GERBERS_DIR` = `'@FABRICATION_DIR@/Gerbers'` · `JLCPCB_DIR` = `'@MANUFACTURING_DIR@/JLCPCB'` · `PANEL_DIR` = `'@MANUFACTURING_DIR@/Panel'` · `FAB_DRILL_TABLES_DIR` = `'@FABRICATION_DIR@/Drill Tables'` · `TESTING_DIR` = `Testing` · `TESTPOINTS_DIR` = `'@TESTING_DIR@/Testpoints'` · `IMAGES_DIR` = `Images` · `3D_DIR` = `3D` · `RESOURCES_DIR` = `kibot_resources` · `REPORT_TEMPLATE_DIR` = `'@RESOURCES_DIR@/templates'` · `SCRIPTS_DIR` = `'@RESOURCES_DIR@/scripts'`

### Layer names

User layers of the PCB used by the documents (title page, DNP marks, drill map, test point lists, assembly texts): must match the PCB layer names.

Internal names, change them only with the files using them.

`LAYER_TITLE_PAGE` = `TitlePage` · `LAYER_DNP_TOP` = `F.DNP` · `LAYER_DNP_BOTTOM` = `B.DNP` · `LAYER_DRILL_MAP` = `DrillMap` · `LAYER_TP_LIST_TOP` = `F.TestPointList` · `LAYER_TP_LIST_BOTTOM` = `B.TestPointList` · `LAYER_ASSEMBLY_TEXT_TOP` = `F.AssemblyText` · `LAYER_ASSEMBLY_TEXT_BOTTOM` = `B.AssemblyText` · `LAYER_DNP_CROSS_TOP` = `F.DNP` · `LAYER_DNP_CROSS_BOTTOM` = `B.DNP`

### Filters names

Names of the KiBot filters (kibot_filt_*.yaml) used by the outputs.

Internal names, change them only with the files using them.

`FILT_FIELD_RENAME` = `field_rename` · `FILT_TP_ONLY` = `only_testpoints` · `FILT_TP_EXCLUDE` = `exclude_testpoints` · `FILT_TP_TOP_ONLY` = `only_testpoints_top` · `FILT_TP_BOTTOM_ONLY` = `only_testpoints_bottom`

### Output names

Used as `kibot_image_<name>` / `kibot_table_<name>` in PCB groups

Internal names, change them only with the files using them.

`NETLIST_OUTPUT` = `netlist` · `GERBER_OUTPUT` = `gbr_gerbers` · `ODB_OUTPUT` = `zip_odb` · `EXCELLON_DRILL_OUTPUT` = `drl_excellon` · `PDF_DRILL_MAP_OUTPUT` = `pdf_drill_map` · `DXF_DRILL_MAP_OUTPUT` = `dxf_drill_map` · `CSV_DRILL_TABLE_OUTPUT` = `csv_drill_table` · `CSV_POS_OUTPUT` = `csv_position` · `CSV_TP_OUTPUT` = `csv_testpoints` · `CSV_TP_TOP_OUTPUT` = `csv_testpoints_top` · `CSV_TP_BOTTOM_OUTPUT` = `csv_testpoints_bottom` · `CSV_BOM_OUTPUT` = `csv_bom` · `XLSX_BOM_OUTPUT` = `xlsx_bom` · `HTML_IBOM_OUTPUT` = `html_bom_interactive` · `HTML_BOM_OUTPUT` = `html_bom` · `CSV_COMP_COUNT_OUPUT` = `csv_comp_count` · `CSV_IMPEDANCE_TABLE_OUTPUT` = `csv_impedance_table` · `TXT_FAB_NOTES_OUTPUT` = `txt_fabrication_notes` · `TXT_ASSEMBLY_NOTES_OUTPUT` = `txt_assembly_notes` · `PNG_3D_VIEWER_TOP` = `png_3d_viewer_top` · `PNG_3D_VIEWER_BOTTOM` = `png_3d_viewer_bottom` · `PNG_3D_VIEWER_ANGLED_TOP` = `png_3d_viewer_angled_top` · `PNG_3D_VIEWER_ANGLED_BOTTOM` = `png_3d_viewer_angled_bottom` · `STEP_OUTPUT` = `step` · `PCB3D_OUTPUT` = `pcb3d_blender` · `PDF_SCHEMATIC_OUTPUT` = `pdf_schematic` · `PDF_PCB_ROUTING_OUTPUT` = `pdf_pcb_routing` · `PDF_GERBERS_OUTPUT` = `pdf_gerbers` · `PDF_FABRICATION_OUTPUT` = `pdf_fabrication` · `PDF_ASSEMBLY_OUTPUT` = `pdf_assembly` · `ZIP_COMPRESS_FAB_OUTPUT` = `zip_compress_fab` · `HTML_KICANVAS_OUTPUT` = `html_kicanvas` · `HTML_KIRI_OUTPUT` = `html_kiri` · `MD_README_OUTPUT` = `md_readme` · `HTML_NAV_RES_OUTPUT` = `html_navigate_results`

## kibot_board.yaml: per board definitions

Multi-board repositories (`boards` setting): an optional `kibot_board.yaml` in a board folder overrides `kibot_main.yaml` definitions for that board, one `NAME: value` per line (no indentation), i.e. `BOARD_NAME: 'IO board'`, `PANEL_ROWS: 3`. Written by `./run_kibot.sh --init --dir <board>`, read by the launcher (passed with `-E`).

## Stackup profiles

Files of `kibot_resources/stackups`, applied with `./run_kibot.sh --stackup NAME` (see *Stackup and design rules* in the guide). Profiles: `jlcpcb_2l`, `jlcpcb_4l`, `jlcpcb_6l`, `makera_z1_2l`.

| Entry | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Stackup name, shown in the fabrication document and by `--stackup list` |
| `description` | One line description, shown by `--stackup list` |
| `copper_finish` | Surface finish of the physical stackup, i.e. `HAL lead-free`, `ENIG`, `None` |
| `mask_color` | Solder mask color (stackup and fabrication notes) |
| `silk_color` | Silkscreen color (stackup and fabrication notes) |
| `mask_thickness` | Solder mask thickness in mm (added to the board thickness) |
| `mask_epsilon_r` | Solder mask dielectric constant |
| `solder_mask` | `false`: no solder mask layers in the stackup (i.e. CNC milled boards). Default `true` |
| `silkscreen` | `false`: no silkscreen layers in the stackup. Default `true` |
| `layers` | Top to bottom: `{copper: NAME, type: signal\|power\|mixed\|jumper, thickness}` and `{dielectric: core\|prepreg, material, thickness, epsilon_r, loss_tangent}` |
| `design_rules` | File of kibot_resources/stackups copied to the project `.kicad_dru` (kept if customized) |
| `fabrication_notes` | File of kibot_resources/stackups copied to kibot_resources/templates/fabrication_notes.txt (kept if customized) |
| `board_rules` | *Board Setup → Constraints* minimums (`.kicad_pro` keys, i.e. `min_track_width`, in mm) |
| `via_sizes` | Pre-defined via sizes `[[diameter, drill], ...]` in mm |
| `impedance` | Rows of the impedance table of the fabrication document (`line, impedance, tolerance, layer, width, gap, gnd_gap, ref`), `[]` for *No controlled impedance* |
| `netclasses` | Net classes created or updated (`name, track_width, clearance, diff_pair_width, diff_pair_gap, diff_pair_via_gap, via_diameter, via_drill`), `Default` included |
| `netclass_minimums` | The other net classes are raised to these values (never lowered) |

## kibot_launch.sh / run_kibot.sh options

`run_kibot.sh` (Linux/macOS/WSL/Git Bash) and `run_kibot.ps1` (Windows) start the container and pass the options to `kibot_launch.sh`.

```
USAGE
  ./kibot_launch.sh [OPTIONS] [-- EXTRA_KIBOT_ARGS]

OPTIONS
  -v, --variant VARIANT       Project status / variant: DRAFT, PRELIMINARY, CHECKED,
                              RELEASED, or an assembly variant name.
                              Default: 'variant' in kibot_settings.yaml (currently: <variant>).
  --version VERSION           Revision to print in the documents. Default: computed
                              from CHANGELOG.md (e.g. '1.0.0+ (Unreleased)').
  -r, --render ENGINE         3D render engine: kicad (fast) or blender (photo-realistic).
                              Default: RENDER_ENGINE in kibot_yaml/kibot_main.yaml.
  --costs                     Only generate the XLSX costs BoM (KiCost, needs API keys in
                              kibot_yaml/kicost_config_local.yaml).
  --log-dir DIR               Store the KiBot logs in DIR.
  --skip-checks               Don't run the manufacturing checks after the generation.
  --no-variants               Don't generate the assembly_variants of kibot_settings.yaml after
                              a CHECKED / RELEASED run.
  --board DIR                 Multi-board repository: only the KiCad project of DIR (outputs
                              in DIR). Default: all the 'boards' of kibot_settings.yaml.
  --stackup NAME|list         Apply a stackup profile of kibot_resources/stackups to the PCB
                              (copper layers, stackup, design rules, impedance net classes,
                              zones refilled).
                              Close the board in KiCad first. 'list' shows the profiles.
  --force                     With --stackup: remove copper layers even if they are used.
  --no-fill                   With --stackup: don't refill the zones.
  --diagrams                  Import Diagrams/<Sheet name>.drawio|svg|png in the sheets (run
                              it with run_kibot.sh / run_kibot.ps1: they export the .drawio).
  --fit                       With --diagrams: center and fit the pictures again.
  --server [PORT]             Start an HTTP server to browse the outputs (default: 8000).
  --stop-server               Stop the running HTTP server.
  --init [OPTIONS]            Set the project metadata and rename the project files, asks
                              when not given: --project, --board, --company, --designer,
                              --name (KiCad files name), --dir DIR (board of a multi-board
                              repository), -y (don't ask).
  -h, --help                  Display this help message.

RUNNER OPTIONS (run_kibot.sh / run_kibot.ps1 only)
  --shell                     Interactive shell in the KiBot container.
  --serve [PORT]              Browse the outputs on http://localhost:PORT (default: 8000).
  --setup-libs                Add/update the shared libraries (lib_<VAR>_url in
                              kibot_settings.yaml) as git submodules.
  --update-libs               Move the libraries to the latest commit of their branch.
  --check-libs                Fail if a declared library is missing (run_kibot.sh).

EXAMPLES
  ./kibot_launch.sh                        Run with the variant from kibot_settings.yaml.
  ./kibot_launch.sh -v DRAFT               Schematic PDF, netlist and BoM only.
  ./kibot_launch.sh -v CHECKED -r blender  All outputs, ERC/DRC, Blender renders.
  ./kibot_launch.sh --costs                XLSX costs spreadsheet in Manufacturing/Assembly.
  ./kibot_launch.sh -v LITE                Assembly variant (KiCad 10 variant), outputs in Variants/LITE.
  ./kibot_launch.sh --board hw/io          Multi-board repository: only the board of hw/io.
  ./kibot_launch.sh --server 8080          Browse the outputs on http://localhost:8080.
  ./kibot_launch.sh --stackup jlcpcb_2l    Switch to the JLCPCB 2 layers stackup, rules and net classes.
  ./kibot_launch.sh --stackup makera_z1_2l CNC milled board (Makera Z1): unplated 2 layers, milling rules.
  ./run_kibot.sh --diagrams                Import Diagrams/Block Diagram.drawio in the Block Diagram sheet.

VARIANT DESCRIPTIONS
  DRAFT:       only schematic in progress, generates schematic PDF, netlist and BoM
  PRELIMINARY: generates both schematic and PCB documents, but no ERC/DRC
  CHECKED:     generates both schematic and PCB documents, with ERC/DRC
  RELEASED:    similar to CHECKED, used for releases (automatic on tags in CI)
  Other:       assembly variants, run like RELEASED, outputs saved in Variants/<name>
```
